annotations.title: Semantic search over EU case law

description: Embedding-based search over EU case law — finds cases by meaning, not exact keywords. Returns relevance-scored matches with ECLI, court, case name/number, and (where available) full text. Requires a paid LexAPI plan; returns 403 on FREE tier.

filters.description: Optional filters passed through to the LexAPI semantic backend. See the LexAPI docs at https://lex-api.com/docs for accepted filter keys (e.g. court, dateFrom, dateTo, ecli).

min_score.description: Drop results below this cosine similarity (0–1).

name: lex_semantic_case_law
